candidates.name: Aquila Pipeline (Eagle Mountain)
candidates.sponsor: Williams (MountainWest Pipeline) for Will-Power UT, LLC
candidates.to: Will-Power Eagle Mountain gas plant, Eagle Mountain, Utah

evidence.note: Williams customer meeting slides describe a service pipeline of about 19 miles plus a lateral of about 1 mile off Kern River for the Aquila plants, with in-service dates in the second half of 2027 and first half of 2028.
Spring 2026 shipper advisory board slides repeat the Aquila lateral plan.
Utah Public Service Commission notice of registration for the Aquila generation, listing about 286 megawatts and a gas line of about 20 miles.
Utah air permit application for the Eagle Mountain power plant, gas turbines and engines at Pony Express Parkway.
Local article on the campus with two power systems.
City page lists the Meta data center in Eagle Mountain.

candidates.why_maybe_new: A new gas service pipeline of about 19 to 20 miles feeding a plant built to power a Meta data center campus. It is not in the roster. Length figures vary from 18.9 to 20 miles and plant size from 286 to 520 megawatts across sources. The seed names Will-Power, OH LLC, but every filing says Will-Power UT, LLC.

seed_ledger.name: Altamont Green River Pipeline Project
seed_ledger.reason: The project is a gathering line of about 43 miles and 20 inches carrying Uinta Basin gas to the Chipeta processing plant. It went into service in September 2025. Kinder Morgan says it relieves production constraints and cuts flaring. No source ties it to a data center or power plant. Searches turned up Crusoe flare-gas units in the basin from 2023, which are a different project. Searches run: 9. Sources checked: Kinder Morgan second-quarter 2024 and third-quarter 2025 earnings releases (project scope, in-service date); Western Midstream 2025 annual report (Chipeta interconnect finished, 150 MMcf/d); a Bureau of Land Management press release on the Chipeta slug catcher line (flaring and trucking reduction); Utah Public Service Commission docket index (safety filings only); Uinta Basin data center and gas power searches (nothing tied); Kinder Morgan data center commentary (no Utah Uinta tie).

evidence.note: Placed in service September 2025, relieves Uinta Basin constraints.
43 miles, 20 inch, 150 MMcf/d to Western Chipeta plant.
Chipeta interconnect for up to 150 MMcf/d completed in 2025.
Purpose is flaring reduction in the Altamont and Bluebell area.

seed_ledger.name: Naughton Coal-to-Gas Conversion
seed_ledger.reason: This is a Northwest Pipeline expansion of about 98 Mdth/d with no new pipe, serving the PacifiCorp Naughton plant conversion in Wyoming. Williams reports it in service in April 2026. Eight searches found no data center or large load named as a reason. Kept as monitor in case a Lincoln County data center load is later tied to the plant. Searches run: 8. Sources checked: Williams second-quarter 2026 quarterly report (expansion in service April 2026); WyoFile coverage of the Naughton conversion (utility reliability reasons only); PacifiCorp plan filings (no data center load); Lincoln County news (no data center tie).

evidence.note: Williams quarterly report mentions the Naughton expansion in service.

seed_ledger.name: Eagle Mountain Power Station (Will-Power)
seed_ledger.reason: Williams plans a gas service pipeline of about 19 miles from the MountainWest Goshen interconnect to the Aquila plant at Eagle Mountain, Utah, plus a lateral of about 1 mile off Kern River. The plant powers the Meta data center campus per the city and local reporting. The state filing gives 286 megawatts and 20 miles. Williams slides give 520 megawatts across two sites and 19 plus 1 miles. Owner is Will-Power UT, LLC, not Will-Power, OH LLC as the seed says. The row is not in the roster. Searches run: 12. Sources checked: Utah air permit application and notice (turbines and engines at Eagle Mountain); Utah Public Service Commission registration notice (286 megawatts, 20 miles); Williams customer and shipper slides (19 mile pipeline, 2027 and 2028 dates); Eagle Mountain city page (Meta campus); a local newsletter on the campus power system.

evidence.note: 19 mile service pipeline and 1 mile lateral.
Meta data center in Eagle Mountain.
